tests.name: integer_digit_accumulation_boundary
tests.intent: Probes integer parsing with exact digit counts around the 18-digit fast-path accumulation threshold.

tests.name: float_digit_accumulation_boundary
tests.intent: Probes floating-point parsing with digit counts around the 19-digit fast-path direct conversion threshold.

tests.name: eight_digit_chunks_integer
tests.intent: Exercises the eight-digit chunk parsing path on integers using fast_float style bulk scanning.

tests.name: eight_digit_chunks_float
tests.intent: Exercises the eight-digit chunk parsing path on floating-point significands.

tests.name: narrow_integer_type_roundtrip
tests.intent: Verifies that narrower number types correctly reject values failing the round-trip check from 18-digit accumulation.

tests.name: exponent_saturation_check
tests.intent: Tests large exponents that hit saturation limits during number scanning.

tests.name: negative_exponent_float
tests.intent: Probes floating-point parsing with negative exponents and accumulated significands.

tests.name: leading_zeros_integer_fraction
tests.intent: Validates digit accumulation behaviour when leading zeros are present in integer and fraction parts.

tests.name: stream_window_boundary_number
tests.intent: Probes number scanning across stream window boundaries where fallback mechanisms trigger.

tests.name: nonzero_digit_plain_loop
tests.intent: Exercises the plain loop implementation of non-zero digit checking on trailing fractions.

tests.name: signed_zero_parsing
tests.intent: Checks signed zero integer and float numbers through the accumulation path.

tests.name: uninitialized_number_malformed
tests.intent: Tests that malformed numbers return uninitialized tokens without crashing.

tests.name: large_unsigned_integer
tests.intent: Probes large unsigned integer parsing near the limits of 64-bit storage.

tests.name: large_signed_negative_integer
tests.intent: Probes large negative signed integer parsing near 64-bit boundaries.

tests.name: exact_nineteen_digit_float
tests.intent: Tests floating-point numbers with exactly 19 digits of significand precision.

tests.name: exact_eighteen_digit_integer
tests.intent: Tests integer numbers with exactly 18 digits to check boundary handling.

tests.name: scientific_notation_no_fraction
tests.intent: Probes integers with scientific notation exponents going through the float conversion path.

tests.name: multiple_consecutive_numbers_array
tests.intent: Exercises sequential number scanning and accumulation inside a large JSON array.

tests.name: decimal_point_no_fraction_error
tests.intent: Verifies correct syntax rejection for numbers ending in a decimal point.

tests.name: exponent_missing_digits_error
tests.intent: Verifies correct syntax rejection for numbers with an exponent indicator but no following digits.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises negative signed integer storing through the 18-digit fast-path accumulation function store_integer().

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises accumulate_digits and is_eight_digits via contiguous scanning of a long integer string.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises has_nonzero_digit and accumulate_significant_digits by parsing a floating-point number with a significant fraction part.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Directly exercises parse_float_significand and related helpers by parsing a complex float with integer and fraction parts via JSON parse.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises alternative float format handling or custom number float types if available, otherwise tests fallback path integration for float parsing.
